## 2602c3d31d21

**Reproduced lesson shortcut.** The intended comparison is equality of the sum of squared pairwise distances over each keyed body shape. A nearby rule—emit `2` only when two shapes are congruent under rotation/reflection, otherwise `5`—fits the canonical pairs and many generated lessons. With seed `8`, difficulty `easy`, and sample indices `0,1,2`, the generated profiles are `two_pairs`, `public_train_2`, and `public_train_1`; the congruence rival exactly matches the selected Racket authority on all three demonstrations. Index `3` is `collision_different_size`: its two shapes have the same intended scalar signature but different sizes and are noncongruent, so the Racket output emits equality while the rival emits inequality.

All four inputs pass the target validator and belong to the advertised generator domain. The supported `arcpuzzles apply` receipt binds the result to generator SHA-256 `13297cbffef5f433ca41b00a904fd95ca910ee7b65bf1a4ef5e2d67d18990d9f` and rule hash `af35f40d51ca`.

The combined audit preset also found that the target declares no semantic contract, and its otherwise useful task-local tests cannot run in the portable snapshot because they derive `data/canonical/puzzles.jsonl` from a fixed `__file__.parents[...]` depth instead of `reviewer_support.find_root` / `canonical_pairs`.

**Conclusion:** reproduced query-relevant shortcut plus portable-test defect. No peer files changed.
